prompt.alinti: You built an app with AI. It works. But it looks like every other vibe coded app on the internet: same flat buttons, same grey cards, same landing page everyone has already seen.

That’s the part nobody tells you about building with Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable or Bolt. The AI can write the code, but it has no taste. It reaches for the same default UI every single time, so your product ends up looking like a weekend project even when the idea is good.
Real startups fix this with a design team. You can fix it with one command.

We found a UI component library made for people who build with AI. It has 60+ animated UI components that are free forever, with 832+ examples: buttons, dialogs, tabs, menus, drawers, tables, toasts, all with motion built in.
